recG4mC1e79KaK37p.Bio: Jason Quitt is a Canadian author and researcher of ancient mysticism, sacred geometry and archaeo-astronomy, and the founder of The Crystal Sun. A graduate of the Institute of Energy Wellness who has studied energy modalities, shamanism and Qi Gong since 2002, he has taught and lectured on mysticism, meditation and out of body experience since 2010. His books include Egyptian Postures of Power, The Yosef Codes, Astral Genesis, Gates of the Anunnaki and Astral Experiences. His latest, The Shining Island: Precession, Axis Mundi, & Plato's Celestial Allegory, reads Plato's Atlantis not as a sunken empire but as a celestial allegory encoding the fall of the pole star and the precession of the Great Year.
recG4mC1e79KaK37p.Name: Jason Quitt
recG4mC1e79KaK37p.Role: Author & researcher of ancient mysticism, sacred geometry & archaeo-astronomy

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Born Sensitive, Remembering Past Lives", "body": "Jason grew up assuming everyone shared his experiences, and only between about ten and fifteen did he realize they were unusual. The sensitivity went quiet through high school, then returned in his early twenties with out-of-body experiences and contact, sending him into healing, energy work and shamanism. His earliest memories include past lives glimpsed at the moment of death, and at around eleven he recognized a new classmate from a former life, a friend who is still close today. Chance relates, recalling a childhood sense that his mind worked differently from the adults around him."}, {"title": "Teachers in the Astral Temples", "body": "Jason says the Egyptian postures did not come from temple statues but from dream teachers, met after waking into an altered state inside temples, who taught mostly telepathically: postures, meditations, even which plants to combine for medicine. He was not researching Egypt at the time, and he has also been taken to Hindu, Buddhist and Chinese temples, once shown a book of Qigong postures by a robed monk whose pages he forgot on waking. Chance describes his own temple dream after hearing Jason on Beyond Mystic. Jason took nothing to induce any of it, and his advice is to stop chasing the experience and simply observe it."}, {"title": "Sleep Paralysis as the Doorway", "body": "Chance describes the paralysis that preceded his own out-of-body experiences, an electric feeling at the back of his neck, and a female voice telling him to go with the flow, after which he floated up by the ceiling fan. Jason answers that sleep paralysis and the out-of-body experience are the same thing, a mystical egg the soul cracks to be born into the other world. The astral body wakes like a child, he says, and must be built through Qigong and meditation, face its shadows, and learn a realm that feels more real than physical life, complete with 360-degree sight and a zoom."}, {"title": "Pain as the Messenger", "body": "Jason believes the body carries a built-in mechanism for trauma much like an immune system, though he still goes to the hospital for a broken bone. He describes placing awareness in the breath, drawing it through the lower dantian, heart and mind until it becomes life force, then directing it at the injury, which he says can make the pain worse before it eases. Recounting a slipped disc in his early twenties, he describes a Tesla field generator, focused breathing, a pop and a warm honey sensation running down his legs. Chance links this to Sekhmet, who brings the necessary pain, and Bastet, who brings relief."}, {"title": "The Ren and the Postures of Power", "body": "Chance, a sound healer who works with tuning forks, asks about sound in ancient Egypt, and Jason frames everything as vibration, saying certain temple chambers appear designed around frequency. That leads to the ren, the secret name: know a thing's true name and you hold power over it, which he calls the beginning of magic and the reason sacred names went unspoken. Chance adds that intention may weigh as much as the word, tying it to public and private in the legal system. They close on Egyptian Postures of Power, which Jason calls a tool rather than information and the foundation of all energy work."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Jason Quitt received the Egyptian Postures of Power from astral temples in the dream world where spiritual beings transmitted these practices to him telepathically. This conversation is the story of how that happened and what he brought back.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: Jason Quitt, mystic researcher and author of Egyptian Postures of Power, joins InnerVerse for his first appearance to share a lifetime of direct mystical experience. The conversation covers childhood past life recall and paranormal sensitivity, astral dream teachers in Egyptian, Hindu, Buddhist, and Chinese temples who transmit information telepathically, sleep paralysis as the mystical egg the soul cracks to leave the body, building the astral body through qigong and meditation to navigate the other worlds, 360-degree astral vision with a zoom function, the built-in self-healing mechanism that activates through trauma, healing by moving into pain rather than away from it, the warm honey release of a slipped disc healed through a Tesla field generator and focused intention, the shamanic dismemberment and rebuilding archetype in plant medicine journeys, Sekhmet and Bastet as the destructive and restorative poles of Egyptian healing, sacred frequency chambers in Egyptian temples, and the ren as the secret vibrational name at the heart of Egyptian magic.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The Sacred Name That Outlives the Body", "body": "Jason picks up the ren where the first hour left it and follows it into kingship and burial. A pharaoh was born with one name and received another on taking the throne, and a name given in initiation or ceremony became part of the person's energetic field, a new identity and a new power, sometimes paired with a new birth date. The cartouche, an elongated shen meaning infinite, protected that name for eternity, which is why chiseling names and faces off funerary walls was so grave an act, severing the dead from the earthly plane."}, {"title": "The Many Bodies of the Egyptian Soul", "body": "Jason lays out the Egyptian map of the multi-dimensional human. The ba, drawn as a bird bearing the deceased's face, is the astral body that holds personality and memory, the same body people report floating above the bed in out-of-body experiences. The shadow is a personality-less guardian given at birth by Anubis, likely the root of the Grim Reaper, and it is what first pulled Jason into sleep paralysis. The ib, the heart, records a whole life and is weighed against Maat's feather, while the ka and ba can merge into the akh, a star body."}, {"title": "Myths as Coded Memory of the Sky", "body": "Jason argues that deities are fluid, repackaged across cultures, and that many battles and characters in sacred stories are allegories for celestial events. He points to an ancient site in Turkey that appears to have been deliberately buried around 12,000 years ago, carrying a story of a meteor or asteroid that caused a great flood, and suggests that stars were gods, so falling stars became fallen angels. Chance adds that astrotheology is central to his show and that the best reading of any myth ties it back to what nature actually does."}, {"title": "Ascension, Memory, and the Energy Body", "body": "Jason says ascension in ancient cultures was always about death, and that an uninitiated person meets fear and chaos in that transition. Meditation, breathwork and postures build the ka so you are not pulled or manipulated on the other side, and the ren carries more power there. Chance connects this to coherence in the biofield, describing psychic vampirism as holes in a leaky aura, and calls memory the real power that tethers us across the void. Jason contrasts preserving the dead through statues and offerings with letting go and dissolving back into source."}, {"title": "Creation From Darkness and the Pillar of Shu", "body": "Jason retells creation from Nun, the dark abyss, where Ra speaks his own name and becomes light, and stresses that light always comes out of darkness. He recalls a teacher telling students to close their eyes and meet their black mama. Ra then generates Shu and Tefnut, air and moisture, and Shu holds apart Nut and Geb, sky and earth, which Jason reads as the birth of the atmosphere. Thoth wins five extra days from Ra in a game of senet, and Jason tells listeners that each of us is Shu, the pillar between heaven and earth."}]

You have to build it.", "author": "Jason Quitt", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/71bee0cb-99ee-4785-ba9d-5d867e75cbbe/JASON-QUITT.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Memory is like the real power, it's your tether across the chasm, the abyss of the void.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "We are beings that are in between two states, the state of illumination and the state of nothingness, and we have to learn both of those.", "author": "Jason Quitt", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/71bee0cb-99ee-4785-ba9d-5d867e75cbbe/JASON-QUITT.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "We need this empty space because that's the medium through which we see things.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "We are given these maps of consciousness, and they're just maps.
